name: vroom
description: Mobile-first Skia candlestick chart library — monorepo root

scripts.test:core: cmake -S packages/core -B packages/core/build -DVROOM_BUILD_TESTS=ON && cmake --build packages/core/build --target vroom_tests && ctest --test-dir packages/core/build --output-on-failure

pnpm.//: Security floors for transitives stuck behind docusaurus/expo/tsup parents. Each override is temporary — delete it once the parent ships a fixed range (pnpm why <pkg> to check). The scoped @expo/plist override is a floor too, not an exemption: @expo/plist@0.8.1 declares ^0.8.8 and calls parseFromString() without a mimeType, which 0.9.x rejects (it breaks `expo prebuild`), so it gets 0.8.15 — the patched release of the 0.8 line, which fixes every advisory 0.9.12 does. Drop it once @expo/plist moves to 0.9.x. The scoped @docusaurus/core>tinypool override crosses a major: @docusaurus/core (through 3.10.2) declares ^1.0.2 and no 1.x is patched. Its SSG pool only uses options 2.x still supports and loads it via dynamic import(), so ESM-only 2.x works (verified with DOCUSAURUS_SSG_WORKER_THREADS=2). Drop it once docusaurus moves to tinypool 2.

auditConfig.//: image-size has no fixed release — every version through 2.0.2 (the latest) is affected, so there is nothing to pin. Both advisories are parser denial-of-service reached only at build time, via docusaurus's mdx-loader and expo's metro, on images from this repo; neither path ships in a published package. Drop these once docusaurus/expo pick up a fixed image-size. node-forge (GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv) has no fixed release either — 1.4.0 (the latest) is affected, and the newest @expo/cli still depends on it. It is reached only via @expo/cli in examples/test-bench and ships in no published package. Drop it once node-forge publishes a fix. braces (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm) has no fixed release — 3.0.3 (the latest) is affected, and micromatch 4.0.8 (the latest) still requires it. It is reached only through build/dev tooling (changesets, docusaurus, metro) and ships in no published package. Drop it once braces publishes a fix.
